title: The Shirt
summary: A sudden gust of wind blew Nasruddin's freshly washed linen shirt off the drying line on the second-story balcony, dropping it onto the stone flagstones below....
full_text:
A sudden gust of wind blew Nasruddin's freshly washed linen shirt off the drying line on the second-story balcony, dropping it onto the stone flagstones below.

Nasruddin immediately prostrated himself on the floor, offering prayers of thanksgiving.

His wife was bewildered: "Why are you praying because your shirt fell into the dirt?"

"Can you not see the miracle?" exclaimed Nasruddin. "Thank heaven I was not inside the shirt when it fell! Otherwise, I would have broken all my bones upon the stones!"
moral: A cheerful mind finds reasons for gratitude even in minor accidents.
